items.quote: MCP server created for Freshdesk, allowing AI models to interact with Freshdesk modules.
items.why: Quote describes an MCP server for AI models; no cloud helpdesk, Freshworks, or ticketing content.

items.quote: Freshdesk MCP uses API key authentication.
items.why: States API key auth only; no Basic-username detail or OAuth absence.

items.quote: Only SSL calls (HTTPS) will be allowed.
items.why: Confirms HTTPS-only; says nothing on REST v2, resources, or 429 limits.

items.quote: For every trial period the API limit is 50 per minute.
items.why: Gives trial 50/min figure; does not state Free plan lacks API access.

items.quote: When you sign up, you instantly get access to our Enterprise plan for 14 days.
items.why: Confirms 14-day Enterprise trial; no paid-tier gate or Free-plan-zero detail.

items.quote: MCP is supported only in Freshdesk 2021 and Freshdesk Unified Omni 2026.
items.why: Says MCP supported in specific Freshdesk versions; no vendor-official or server-exists confirmation beyond that.

items.quote: The number of API calls you can make is based on your plan.
items.why: Says API calls depend on plan; the blocker, API-key, and subdomain verdict are not stated.
